zh-Hans: 能控制轮胎的负担，才算一流！
en: Controlling the load on your tires is what makes you first-rate!

zh-Hans: 把该做的事做好，然后赢下比赛！
en: Do the basics properly, and take the win!
You've got some skill, I'll give you that.

zh-Hans: 只要像这样跟在后面，你的跑法我就看得一清二楚！
en: From back here, I can read your driving like an open book!
Don't think this is over!
You think you can escape? Not a chance!

zh-Hans: 赛车运动磨炼的技术，怎么可能输给街头那套幼稚把戏！
en: Techniques honed in motorsport can't possibly lose to childish street tricks!

zh-Hans: 轮胎还有余力，抓地牢得很！
en: The tires have plenty left. They're gripping hard!
Don't get cocky!
Fast!

zh-Hans: 小聪明罢了。以为这样就能抗衡我的偏时点火系统？
en: Clever little trick. Think that's enough to take on my anti-lag system?
You bastard!
Idiot! Do you want to die?!
Impossible! You've got to be kidding!
Damn it all!
No! I can't get on the gas!
Ugh! Impossible!
What?!
Tch!
Unbelievable!
How could I...?

zh-Hans: 这山路天赋，简直难以置信！
en: His feel for mountain roads is unbelievable!

zh-Hans: 难以置信，那车身控制简直是神技！
en: I can hardly believe it. That car control is almost supernatural!

zh-Hans: 我练过金卡纳，就算以我的眼光看，你的最快路线也无可挑剔！
en: Even to an eye trained in gymkhana, your racing line is flawless!

zh-Hans: 怎么办？豁出去让轮胎多吃点负担，提速吗？
en: What now? Push the pace and accept the extra load on the tires?
He won't drop back!

zh-Hans: 始终保持着一样的距离！
en: He's holding the gap exactly!

zh-Hans: 什么都不做，反而更让人不安。
en: The fact that he's doing nothing is even more unsettling.

zh-Hans: 值得夸一句，简直像在玩杂技！
en: I'll give you credit. That's practically an acrobatic stunt!

zh-Hans: 对我来说，这不过是和平常一样冲线罢了。
en: For me, this is just another routine finish.

zh-Hans: 说四驱车不肯转弯，那早就是老黄历了。我的 EVO III 可会转！
en: The days when four-wheel drive wouldn't turn are long gone. My EVO III turns!

zh-Hans: 技术再高超，不能换来速度，就只是杂技罢了。
en: However advanced a technique is, if it doesn't make you faster, it's just a stunt.

zh-Hans: 盯上的猎物，我绝不放跑！
en: I never let my prey escape!

zh-Hans: 这算不上长直道，不过甩掉你已经够了！
en: It's hardly a long straight, but it's long enough to shake you!
You can't escape my counterattack!

zh-Hans: 从这里开始，我也要全力跑了。一瞬间就结束！
en: I'm going all out from here too. It'll be over in an instant!

zh-Hans: 偏时点火系统和四驱的真本事，现在才开始！
en: Now you'll see what anti-lag and four-wheel drive can really do!
You think you can get away?
This battle is mine!
Pathetic!
Too slow!
You're not getting away!
Small fry.
Heh-heh-heh...
I can win. I can win this battle!

zh-Hans: 不管来的是什么车，我都不能在这种地方输！
en: Whatever car I'm up against, I can't lose here!

zh-Hans: 拿下了。这是我再熟悉不过的赢法！
en: It's mine. This is how it always goes for me!

zh-Hans: 大马力涡轮加四驱，少了这两样，就不配叫车！
en: High-powered turbo plus four-wheel drive. Anything less isn't a car!
